descriptions: A gap in a wall of reeds twice your height, where a channel of still water leads in. Someone has cut a path along it.
features: A red rag tied to a reed stem, marking the way out.
ambient: The reeds hiss in the wind.

descriptions: A channel of slow water winds between the reeds, too deep to wade far.
A narrow channel where the reeds meet overhead like a roof.
features: A punt pole stuck upright in the mud.

descriptions: Reeds on every side, so tall and close you can see only straight up.
A trampled reedbed, as if something heavy lay down here.
ambient: The reeds whisper together, and fall silent as you pass.

descriptions: A little island of willow roots, just big enough to stand on.
A muddy islet where someone once lit a fire.
features: A ring of blackened stones and fish bones.
ambient: A frog plops into the water.

descriptions: Tall dead trees stand in the water here, crowned with untidy nests.
A stand of alders full of herons, who watch you with yellow eyes.
features: A heron's feather, as long as your forearm.
ambient: A heron croaks like a door hinge.

descriptions: A still backwater, green with duckweed, where the channel gives up.
A dead end of open water, ringed with reeds, very quiet.
ambient: Midges rise in a cloud and settle again.
